newsitem.title: USA: Hydro-Quebec to end 735 KV substation work next wk.
newsitem.headline: Hydro-Quebec to end 735 KV substation work next wk.

text.p: Canada's Hydro-Quebec said Tuesday it will complete maintenance work on its 735 kilovolt (KV) Radisson substation next week.
The Radisson facility transmits output from the mammouth 5,328 megawatt (MW) La Grande-2 hydroelectric dam near James Bay in northwestern Quebec.
The scheduled project which began April 26 reduced power export to New England by 300 MW via its interconnection north of Vermont, by a company spokeswoman said.
"The amount of power is somewhat reduced," she said, adding that gateway normally carries 900 MW of energy.
